plugins.name: CPA Grok2API Egress
plugins.description: CLIProxyAPI operations page and egress quality guard for grok2api. Embeds a compact management UI for live guard status, statistics and events; node add/edit/delete/enable/disable/search and batch operations; connectivity checks and real-model quality tests; editable active/passive/hybrid guard policy; and server-side grok2api administrator login so proxy URLs and administrator credentials are never returned to the browser. Manages only grok_build nodes; saved proxy URLs are write-only.
